title: For Equifax, Trust Demands Constant Vigilance
summary: Equifax cybersecurity leader Jeremy Koppen shares how earning customer trust depends on the company being careful about what it trusts.
body_markdown:
Insight


# For Equifax, Trust Demands Constant Vigilance


October 12, 2026


Equifax plays an important role in the lives of consumers, and it takes that responsibility seriously. The company continues to deliver on its commitment to being an industry leader in security, building a culture where security is part of the global team’s DNA.


In a new video recognizing Cybersecurity Awareness Month, Equifax Chief Information Security Officer Jeremy Koppen speaks to the importance of earning and maintaining trust from customers, consumers, and partners in each of the markets the company serves. This approach requires a security-first culture built on constant vigilance.


“When customers can see how rigorously we verify everything on the inside, they have good reason to trust us from the outside,” Koppen said. “Security is a part of our DNA, and we’ve built a culture where everyone in Equifax owns security.”


Watch the video to learn more about how Equifax approaches cybersecurity and its commitment to building and maintaining trust.
